@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem fst_div (a b : G × H) : (a / b).1 = a.1 / b.1 := rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem snd_div (a b : G × H) : (a / b).2 = a.2 / b.2 := rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mk_div_mk (x₁ x₂ : G) (y₁ y₂ : H) : (x₁, y₁) / (x₂, y₂) = (x₁ / x₂, y₁ / y₂) := rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem snd_div (a b : G × H) : (a / b).2 = a.2 / b.2 := rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mk_div_mk (x₁ x₂ : G) (y₁ y₂ : H) : (x₁, y₁) / (x₂, y₂) = (x₁ / x₂, y₁ / y₂) := rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem swap_div (a b : G × H) : (a / b).swap = a.swap / b.swap := rfl

/-- The norm on a `NormedField`, as an `AbsoluteValue`. -/
@[simps]
def NormedField.toAbsoluteValue (R : Type*) [NormedField R] : AbsoluteValue R ℝ where
  toFun     := norm
  map_mul'  := norm_mul
  nonneg'   := norm_nonneg
  eq_zero' _ := norm_eq_zero
  add_le'   := norm_add_le
